title: cleome spinosa var. horrida
intro: Cleome spinosa var. horrida, commonly known as Spiny Bee Plant, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cleome spinosa var. horrida include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
